text:
alex-sales: Hey team - Newton Bank POC kickoff. Requirements: streaming with SSE fallback, structured function/tool calls, on-prem connector (VPC), SAML SSO, and offline KMS support. They want a pricing estimate and a short checklist of blockers.

jordan-eng: Got it. Which SDKs? They mentioned a Go edge proxy + Python backend orchestration.

alex-sales: Correct. Go at edge for handshake/adapter, Python for server-side. Also need ephemeral creds for edge agents behind corp proxies.

sara-ml: For streaming, recommend WebSocket default, SSE for corp proxies. We can emit incremental tool-call parts so UI can show streaming results. Sample streamed fragment:

```json
{"evt":"tool_call.part","id":"tc-77","payload":{"name":"acct_lookup","partial":"{\"acct\":\"...\"}"}}
```

jordan-eng: Ephemeral token header example (Go):

```go
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", fmt.Sprintf("Bearer %s", token))
req.Header.Set("X-Req-Id", reqID)
```

devops-bot: Note: if they expect sustained >400 qps, recommend Dedicated pool. Hosted burst available but costs more. See /pricing/reserved-capacity for details.

alex-sales: They expect ~150 qps steady, spikes to 800 qps. Any quick ballpark I can email?

jordan-eng: Rough: hosted pay-as-you-go is ~2-3x per-token vs committed Dedicated. For 150 qps steady, a small Dedicated commitment + hosted burst is usually cost-effective. Exact depends on model size + quant. I'll follow up with a range.

sara-ml: Security questionnaire: we support SAML SSO, SOC2, and can integrate with customer HSM for Private/on-prem. For offline KMS tests we provide a connector and test keys. I can share SOC2 summary and pen-test note.

jordan-eng: POC blockers checklist: 1) IP allowlist or VPN/VPC peering, 2) exchange SAML metadata, 3) temporary KMS/HSM access plan or test creds, 4) acceptance prompt set and eval criteria. If they can't allowlist, we can run a short-lived site-to-site VPN or an agent.

alex-sales: Please drop the docs: allowlist IPs, SAML steps, ephemeral token snippets, dedicated estimator, and security contact. I need a one-pager for the customer.

sara-ml: Will share SOC2 + pen-test summary and a small eval set for structured outputs.

jordan-eng: I'll prepare allowlist + Go snippet + a minimal runbook for the edge proxy integration. Aim to share by EOD tomorrow.

devops-bot: Reminder: request Dedicated trial early if committing - GPU lead time ~3-4 weeks.

alex-sales: Thanks everyone. Target POC kickoff in ~2 weeks pending SAML and network. :thumbsup:

[thread end]
